description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). A short boxy dark grey main body block with a flat ridged strip along its top and a low notched block standing at the back end of the strip. In front of the main body a stubby dark grey front box with rows of small round holes in its side, a short round dark grey tube sticking out of its front end, and on its top an upright orange hoop. Under the front box a matte black vertical front handle with ribbed lower rings. Under the middle of the main body a long straight matte black bar-shaped box hanging straight down from a square socket, with an orange bottom plate. Behind it a small curved lever inside a rounded dark grey loop and a matte black handle raked backward. At the rear a matte black wire shoulder piece: two thin parallel rods, one above the other, running straight back from a small hinge block to a small flat end plate. Bright orange accents: the bottom plate of the long box, a round knob on the left flank of the main body, and the upright hoop on the front box. A small dark grey lever on the left flank above the raked handle. The right flank is plain.
proportions: About 0.62 m long, 0.06 m wide and 0.28 m tall. (length : width : height = 10.33 : 1 : 4.67)
sides: the round orange knob and the small dark grey lever are on the left flank; the right flank is plain; everything else is symmetric left to right.

faces.side: The prop is level: the top strip and the short front tube exactly horizontal, the short tube at the left end of the image, the orange hoop on top of the front box, the front handle below the front box, the long straight box with its orange bottom plate hanging down from the middle, the loop and the raked handle behind it, the two thin rods and the small end plate at the right end of the image.

faces.rear: Seen from the rear end: the small flat end plate is in front on the centre line, the square rear face of the main body shows around it with the notched block on top, the raked handle and the long box with its orange bottom plate hang below on the centre line.
